.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/auth.ts.name: Credential setup checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/auth.ts.description: Checks whether the GitHub and cloud credentials required by the chosen setup are present.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/ci-yml.ts.name: Automation workflow checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/ci-yml.ts.description: Checks automated test workflows for unsafe shell input, missing checks and outdated contracts.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/github.ts.name: GitHub setup checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/github.ts.description: Checks branch protection, automation permissions and issue-board settings without changing them.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/index.ts.name: Installation results
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/index.ts.description: Runs post-installation checks and writes a unified checklist of blockers and setup advice.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/managed.t.name: Managed file checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/managed.t.description: Finds stale managed content, duplicate blocks and missing assistant hooks.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/suppressi.name: Advisory preferences
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/suppressi.description: Applies project-declared advisory exclusions while retaining blockers.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/tools.ts.name: Local tool checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/after/tools.ts.description: Finds missing checking tools, unfinished gate commands and dependency-updater setup.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/context-.name: Evidence source checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/context-.description: Checks that evidence instructions cover required contexts, prepare tools and bound their output.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/env.ts.name: Environment setup checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/env.ts.description: Finds missing local settings, blank credentials and blocked environment loading.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/files.ts.name: Shared file checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/files.ts.description: Detects managed-content drift, duplicate ignore rules and conflicting test reporting.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/index.ts.name: Pre-install checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/index.ts.description: Collects setup findings before installation writes project files.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/mcp.ts.name: Tracker connection checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/mcp.ts.description: Finds missing or extra assistant connections for the selected issue tracker.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/repo.ts.name: Repository readiness checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/repo.ts.description: Checks repository settings, plan format and command availability before installation.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/version..name: Installed version checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/before/version..description: Compares the recorded installation version with the installing package.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/status-holes.ts.name: Missing progress checks
.bkit/core/engine/checks/status-holes.ts.description: Finds gaps in recorded workflow progress and reports them as advisories.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/catalogue..name: Setup advice catalogue
.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/catalogue..description: Defines recommendations for tools, templates and settings the project has not adopted.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/detect.ts.name: Setup advice probes
.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/detect.ts.description: Inspects local assistant settings and checking tools to determine relevant setup advice.

.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/index.ts.name: Setup advice output
.bkit/core/engine/checks/tips/index.ts.description: Collects relevant recommendations and formats them for commands and installation reports.
